# Handoff — Additional Costs dashboard card + GetDashboard BFF restructure

**Branch:** `feat/bk-dash-polyglot` · **Main commit:** `9180dcd0` (`feat(dashboard): additional costs card + dashboard BFF + SDK regen`). My work is **committed** (working tree clean for these paths). The only *uncommitted* tree changes are a **parallel job's** (`packages/api/typescript/src/{sales/objects/OrderOverrideFields, shared/objects/Money}*`) — **do not touch those.**

---

## 1. What this is

The **"Custos Adicionais" (Additional Costs)** dashboard card — a Storybook-showcased, MSW-backed **connected** component — plus a restructured **`GetDashboard`** BFF contract (faker-backed) and several **shared-primitive fixes** (GradientIcon, Tooltip) made along the way.

The card is **NOT wired into the dashboard route** — it's developed/previewed in Storybook only. The route (`routes/(app)/dashboard/index.tsx`) is still the placeholder, but its search schema is defined for later wiring.

Full spec: **`.specs/2026-06-03-additional-costs-card-design.md`** (incl. UI Composition + Open Questions OQ-1..5).

---

## 2. File map

**Frontend — the card** (`packages/app/react/src/routes/(app)/dashboard/-components/AdditionalCostsSection/`)
- `index.tsx` — **Section**: owns `useGetDashboard`, narrows the union, builds rows from `data.additionalCost`, computes header total.
- `AdditionalCostRow.tsx` — **Leaf**: icon (GradientIcon) + label (tooltip trigger) + red value. `tooltip?: ReactNode`.
- `DiscountCostsToggle.tsx` — store-backed checkbox (uses `useDashboardStore`).
- `CostTooltips.tsx` — `CostTooltipLines` (label:value list) + `OperationalTooltip` (takes `additionalCost.operational` detail directly, owns its i18n/formatting).
- `AdditionalCostsSection.stories.tsx` — 5 stories (Default/Zeroed/National/Consolidated/Loading/ErrorState).

**Frontend — supporting**
- `src/stores/useTenancyStore.ts` (+ `src/stores/index.ts` barrel) — **app-global** `tenancyScope` (persisted).
- `routes/(app)/dashboard/-stores/useDashboardStore.ts` — **route-local** `discountAdditionalCosts` toggle.
- `src/lib/format.ts` — `formatCurrency`, **`MoneyValue = number | Record<currency,number>`**, `formatMoneyValue`, `sumMoney`.
- `src/lib/enums.ts` — **`enumLabel(enumName, value)`** (reads `enums.<EnumName>.<VALUE>` i18n subtree; NOT a hand-map).
- `src/locales/{pt,en}.json` — `dashboard.additionalCosts.*` + top-level `enums.OperationalCostRecurrency.*`.
- `routes/(app)/dashboard/index.tsx` — route search schema = `getDashboardQueryParamsSchema.omit({tenancyScope,startDate,endDate}).and(z.object({startDate,endDate defaults}))`. Component still placeholder.
- `.storybook/main.ts` (staticDirs) + `.storybook/preview.tsx` (MSW init + `mswLoader` + i18n init + locale toolbar). `public/mockServiceWorker.js`. `package.json` (msw + msw-storybook-addon devDeps).

**Shared primitives (app-wide impact)**
- `components/ui/gradient-icon.tsx` — now paints the gradient onto `<path>`s via CSS (`[&_path]:fill-[var(--gi-paint)]`), keyed off `paint`.
- `components/ui/tooltip.tsx` — pure fade (no slide/zoom) + `transform-gpu`/`backface-hidden` (anti-twitch) + per-side arrow color + `pointer-events-none` (safe-zone) + cross-axis arrow pin.

**Backend contract**
- `packages/api/typescript/src/ui/schemas/dashboard.ts` — the Stat/AdditionalCost schemas (mono + consolidated + national).
- `packages/api/typescript/src/ui/usecases/GetDashboard.ts` — `variant()` composition + faker builders (FAKER body, real contract).
- `…/GetDashboard.test.ts` — 6 tests (incl. faker-conforms-to-schema).
- `packages/api/typescript/core/src/utils/OpenAPI.ts` — **fix**: `processSchemaForEnums` promotes `enumRecord`-keyed objects to named SDK enum components. `…/schema/ExtraTypes.ts` — doc note.

**Generated (committed via `bun sdk`)** — `packages/client/dist/typescript/**`, `packages/api/typescript/public/docs/openapi.json`.

---

## 3. The GetDashboard contract (final shape)

`z.discriminatedUnion('kind', [SINGLE_GLOBAL, SINGLE_NATIONAL, MULTI_GLOBAL, MULTI_NATIONAL])`. Faker-only body; **the contract is final**, swap the faker for real Drizzle later.

- **`stat`** — every KPI is `{ metric, details? }`:
  - `revenue/profit/margin/averageTicket/unitsSold/roi/roas` → `{ metric }`
  - `costs` → `{ metric, details: segmented(CostKind) }`
  - `productCost` → `{ metric, details: {product, shipping} }`
  - `fees` → `{ metric, details: {gateway, checkout, chargeback} }`
  - `ads` → `{ metric, details: {byPlatform, byType, tax, cpa} }` (roi/roas pulled out)
  - `orders` → `{ metric: Tally, details: {generated: Tally, paid: Tally} }`
  - `paymentMethods` → `{ metric: Tally, details: {byMethod} }` — **`*_NATIONAL` only**
- **`additionalCost`** (top-level) — `chargeback{byStatus: segmented(DisputeStatus), fees}`, `refund`, `taxes{ads, others}`, `operational{total, items[]}`, `warranty`, + **`draftOrders: Tally`** (`*_NATIONAL` only).
- **`store`** (SINGLE) / **`perStore`** (MULTI). **MULTI_\*** → money leaves are `CurrencyMetric` (record), ratios/counts stay `Metric`.

Card reads: `data.additionalCost.{chargeback,refund,taxes,operational,warranty}` (+ `draftOrders` via kind-narrow), `data.store.currency` (SINGLE).

---

## 4. KEY LEARNINGS (read these before touching anything)

These are also saved as auto-memory (see §6). The biggest traps:

1. **Scaffold first.** New route/component/store/form → `bun cli …` *before* hand-writing (`docs/CLI.md`). Its house rules pre-wire i18n, `.and()`, `className`/CVA — skipping it front-loads review rounds. (This whole feature was hand-written; that caused several correction passes.)
2. **Storybook for *connected* components** (the card calls an SDK hook + `getRouteApi().useSearch()`): MSW (`msw-storybook-addon`) + `QueryClientProvider` + a **stub memory router** that reproduces the exact file-route id with a pathless `createRoute({ id:'(app)' })` + child `path:'x/'` → `/(app)/x/`. ky retries 5xx, so use **400** in error stories. Init i18n in `.storybook/preview.tsx`.
3. **typed i18next.** `t()` keys are type-checked → **literal keys only** (`t('a.b.c')`); a dynamic `t(\`a.b.${k}\`)` returns `unknown` (wall of TS2322). Mirror **both** `pt`/`en`. Enum labels: shared `enums.<EnumName>.<VALUE>` subtree + the **`enumLabel(name, value)`** helper — **not** a per-enum `Record` hand-map.
4. **`tenancyScope` is a global store** (`src/stores/`), never a URL search param. Date range / `productIds` ARE route search params, composed from the SDK `get<X>QueryParamsSchema` via `.omit().and()`.
5. **Backend `tsconfig.build.json` EXCLUDES `*.test.ts`.** It will report 0 errors even when a test you edited is broken. When you touch a `*.test.ts`, ALSO run the **full** `bun x tsc` (and grep your files out of the ~50 pre-existing errors in other contexts' tests).
6. **Consume discriminated-union BFF reads without narrowing** — `data.additionalCost.x.y.value` resolves to `number | Record<currency,number>` across the union. Only narrow (`data.kind === 'SINGLE_*'`) for branch-specific fields (`data.store`, `draftOrders`).
7. **`MoneyValue = number | Record<currency,number>`** (`@/lib/format`) → one render path for mono **and** consolidated (records joined by " · ").
8. **`enumRecord`-only enums weren't exported to the SDK.** An enum lands in the SDK only if the OpenAPI emits it as a named component; `z.enumRecord(E,V)` builds a fixed-key `z.object` (no `enum:[…]` array), so enums used ONLY as record keys (CostKind/DisputeStatus/AdAttribution) were inlined. **Fixed** in `OpenAPI.processSchemaForEnums` (promote enum-keyed objects). After any schema/enum change, run **`bun sdk`** and check `packages/client/dist/typescript/.../types/<Enum>.ts`.
9. **SDK enums are kubb `asConst`** (`export const xEnum = {…} as const` + a string-union `type X`) **BY DEFAULT — not a regression** (git-checked: first-ever SDK enum was already this). They **are** iterable (`Object.values(xEnum)`). **Do NOT flip to `enumType:'enum'`** — it was tried and **reverted**: TS string enums are NOMINAL, so string literals (`'SINGLE_STORE'`, `data.kind === 'SINGLE_GLOBAL'` narrowing) stop type-checking (12 app errors), and a boolean-valued enum (`ListPlatformDescriptors`) isn't a legal TS enum (TS18033) so the SDK won't compile. For `X.MEMBER` syntax, import the real enum from **contracts** (`@bk-dash/contracts-typescript/wire/enums`) for that spot only.
10. **`GradientIcon`** must paint the gradient on the icon's `<path>`s via a CSS rule (`[&_path]:fill-[var(--gi-paint)]`) — the icons set `fill="currentColor"` on paths, which beats an inherited `<svg>` style. **Stroke/line icons must pass `paint="stroke"`** (painting an outline icon with `fill` floods it into a blob — pick fill-based icons for filled rows).
11. **Tooltip arrow twitch** on open = the rotated arrow's anti-aliased edges **re-rasterizing each frame of the opacity fade** (NOT a position bug). Fix = `transform-gpu` (`translateZ(0)`) + `backface-hidden` on popup AND arrow → blends a cached layer. Also: pin the arrow cross-axis (`left-1/2!`) so it doesn't snap to floating-UI's async `arrowStyles.left`; `pointer-events-none` on Positioner+Popup = the "safe zone" (open tooltip doesn't block hovering the next trigger); per-side arrow color matches the `surface` gradient edge (top→8%, bottom→bg).

---

cd packages/api/typescript && bun x tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit
# backend FULL (includes tests — needed after editing any *.test.ts)

9. **SDK enums are kubb `asConst`** (`export const xEnum = {…} as const` + a string-union `type X`) **BY DEFAULT — not a regression** (git-checked: first-ever SDK enum was already this). 11. **Tooltip arrow twitch** on open = the rotated arrow's anti-aliased edges **re-rasterizing each frame of the opacity fade** (NOT a position bug).
